executiveSummary: Guidance remains stable at provisional Elevated 47/100. The Illinois facility-county storm outlook was refreshed without an active county alert at review time. A greater-Milwaukee flood watch, Wisconsin poultry HPAI event and supplier-allergen recall remain unscored until Watershed location, sourcing or product applicability is verified.
baselineNote: Only genuine 17, 18 and 19 September snapshots are available; three points are not a 30/90/365-day trend. Company exposure remains provisional and Cyber / OT remains unassessed.

observations.title: Central Illinois storm outlook refreshed; facility-county guidance remains stable
observations.status: Reviewed; existing S07 guidance and factors unchanged
observations.finding: NWS includes McLean, Woodford and Tazewell in today's central Illinois outlook. Isolated to scattered storms, locally heavy rain and possible damaging winds remain possible, with more storms Sunday. At 16:59 UTC, no active alert matched those three Illinois county SAME codes.
observations.causalPath: County-matched storm potential → possible local road or workforce access interruption → dispatch and production continuity. Actual route, utility and site effects remain unverified.
observations.sourceScope: County/zone outlook and active-alert API check only; absence of an active alert is not an operating clearance or proof of site conditions.
observations.decision: Refresh S07 evidence vintage and 24-hour expiry; retain all seven factors, action, trigger and guidance revision.

observations.title: Southeast Wisconsin flood watch overlaps the disclosed greater-Milwaukee region
observations.status: Unscored regional verification lead; exact Watershed location unknown
observations.finding: NWS extended a Flood Watch through Sunday morning for 11 south-central and southeast Wisconsin counties, including Milwaukee County.
observations.causalPath: Regional heavy rain → possible road, workforce or utility interruption → conditional baking/popping continuity exposure if the unspecified Watershed operation is within an affected area.
observations.sourceScope: Watershed publicly identifies only a greater-Milwaukee presence. Exact municipality, building, routes, utility and any impact are unverified; the watch cannot be assigned to a facility.
observations.decision: Retain as a location-verification lead without changing Facility / weather factors. Escalate only if an operating location matches an applicable warning or verified disruption.

observations.title: Wisconsin confirms HPAI in one Barron County commercial poultry flock
observations.status: Unscored ingredient-category lead; Watershed sourcing unverified
observations.finding: Wisconsin DATCP reports one commercial poultry flock quarantined and depopulated in Barron County; birds from that flock will not enter the food system.
observations.causalPath: Poultry disease/control measures → possible regional animal-protein availability or price effects → conditional pet-nutrition input exposure if Watershed uses affected species or sourcing geography.
observations.sourceScope: Watershed advertises freeze-dried proteins but public evidence does not establish poultry use, Barron County sourcing, a supplier, an affected lot, or a company food-safety incident.
observations.decision: Monitor official outbreak scope and verify actual animal-protein species/geography internally before scoring, changing procurement guidance or inferring product impact.

observations.title: FDA-posted recall illustrates supplier-certificate and incoming-test failure mode
observations.status: Unscored; no Watershed product, ingredient or supplier link
observations.finding: GF Blends recalled flour and baking mixes after third-party testing found gluten in plantain flour represented as gluten-free; the announcement reports no adverse effects as of September 17.
observations.causalPath: Incorrect supplier allergen representation → incoming ingredient/formula and label mismatch → conditional allergen-control risk in blending or baking if an applicable ingredient/supplier match exists.
observations.sourceScope: The named supplier, brands, plantain flour and affected lots are external. No Watershed relationship or use is established; FDA is posting the company's announcement.
observations.decision: Use as a supplier-documentation/incoming-verification lead for Quality only if applicable. No product hold, recall or score increase is warranted without a verified match.

observations.title: Weaver watchlist gains historical private-equity partnership context
observations.status: Historical dossier improvement; not a new 19 September event
observations.finding: Weaver's current company-history page states that it partnered with AUA Private Equity Partners in 2024 and describes a continuing focus on investment in people, processes and capabilities.
observations.causalPath: Financial sponsor relationship → potential capital and capability investment → possible future popcorn/private-label competitive capacity; no realized change is measured.
observations.sourceScope: Publication date, ownership percentage, control, investment amount, capacity additions and utilization are not disclosed. No Watershed relationship is inferred.
observations.decision: Add the 2024 relationship to the competitor watchlist as confirmed company-stated history; watch for dated capex or operating milestones before changing competitive-capacity guidance.

reviewNotes.revision: No factor changed. S01/S13 remain one fuel-cost issue group; unverified weather, HPAI and allergen applicability remain outside the score.

reviewNotes.revision: No. Poultry species/source, Wisconsin municipality/routes and plantain-flour supplier relationships remain unknown. The leads identify verification questions only.

reviewNotes.challenge: Does sponsor language or regional weather establish installed capacity or production interruption?
reviewNotes.revision: No capacity, commissioning, utilization, equipment or outage inference was added. Weaver history changes only competitor context.

reviewNotes.challenge: Does the GF Blends recall warrant a Watershed hold or prove a control failure?
reviewNotes.revision: No matched ingredient, supplier, formula or lot exists publicly. The mechanism is retained as a conditional supplier-documentation/incoming-test lead.

reviewNotes.challenge: Can current CISA material be matched to installed assets?
reviewNotes.revision: CISA primary pages/feed remained inaccessible through the review path and no Watershed asset inventory is public. Cyber / OT remains null rather than zero.

reviewNotes.revision: Illinois active alerts were matched by SAME codes, avoiding the McLean Kentucky false match. The Milwaukee County watch is not assigned to the unspecified greater-Milwaukee Watershed site.
